name: Colombia
description: Colombia from San Agustín and the Muisca to Spanish New Granada, Bolívar, a long civil conflict and the peace of 2016.

checkpoints.name: Before the Spanish
checkpoints.note: Statue-makers worked at San Agustín, and the Muisca and Tairona built chiefdoms of gold.

checkpoints.name: New Granada
checkpoints.note: Spain conquered the land and founded Bogotá and Cartagena. New Granada sent gold and emeralds to Spain.

checkpoints.name: Independence
checkpoints.note: Bolívar won independence in 1819. Liberals and Conservatives fought many wars, and Panama broke away in 1903.

checkpoints.name: Violence and peace
checkpoints.note: La Violencia and then the guerrillas and the cartels brought decades of war. Peace with the FARC came in 2016.
